items.title: A match
items.surface:
A naked man is lying dead in the middle of a desert with a match in his hand. What happened? 

 A man is found dead in a desert. He is naked, and lots of clothes are scattered around him, among other things. There is a match in his hand. How did he die?
items.truth: He was with several others in a hot air balloon crossing the desert. The balloon was punctured and they began to lose altitude. They tossed all their non-essentials overboard, then their clothing and food, but were still going to crash in the middle of the desert. Finally, they drew matches to see who would jump over the side and save the others; this man lost.

items.title: The last taxi
items.surface: Oscar was sitting reading his newspaper, when he heard a noise. When he realized what had happened, he bitterly regretted not having caught the taxi in time. Shortly afterwards, he committed suicide.
items.truth: Oscar was broke. He was a miniature car models collector and, to solve his economic problems, he was going to sell his most valuable car. He had been cleaning it and did not put it down on the table properly when he finished. When he sat down and began to read his newspaper, he heard how it fell off the table. He could not catch it in time before it crashed into the floor.

items.title: An open door
items.surface: When Martin woke up that morning, he was surprised to see the door open. As soon as he crossed the threshold he got beheaded.
items.truth: Martin was a canary that had been living in his cage for four months. Silvester - a cat - was waiting for his opportumity to catch Martin and eat him. When their owner left the cage door open by mistake Martin flew out of it and Silvester bit off his small head.

items.title: The accident
items.surface: A car driver causes an accident when he crashes into a bike, as he was making an unexpected turn at a crossroad. When the policemen arrive, another man gets arrested. The one who was driving is carried home.
items.truth: The driver was receiving driving lessons and his instructor told him to make an incorrect turn at a crossroad, crashing into a bike. The policemen considered the driving instructor to be responsible for the accident so they arrested him and took the learner home.

items.title: The blackout
items.surface: A woman - at work - is going downstairs, when suddenly there is a blackout. In that very moment she realizes that her husband is about to die.
items.truth: The woman worked as an electrician at a hospital and she knew that the emergency generators were broken. He husband had had a car crash and he was at that hospital, connected to a machine that kept him alive. When the blackout happened she knew that her husband couldn't be breathing by himself and therefore that he was dying.

items.title: Not now...!
items.surface: A woman is at home, sad, and watching the street through her window. Soon after she jumps out of it. Just in that precise moment, she hears the telephone ringing and regrets jumping.
items.truth: After a nuclear catastrophe, the woman thought that she was the only person alive and decided to put an end to her life. When the telephone rang she realized that she was not alone. But it was too late for her.

items.title: Witness to a kidnapping
items.surface: A businessman witnesses a kidnapping. However, when he tells the police, they do not believe him.
items.truth: After leaving the dentist, the witness was unable to speak properly, since he had numb mouth. The policemen thought that the man was drunk and did not believe a word he said.

items.title: An unsolved robbery
items.surface: A guy goes into a drugstore and leaves shortly after with the money from the cash register. The drugstore owner calls the Police Station and, some time later, a police officer recovers the money and takes the guy away. That evening the three people go to the police station to report a theft.
items.truth: The guy was the drugstore owner's son. His car had been stolen and he had an important exam. He had been to the drugstore to ask his mother for some money so he could take a taxi. In addition to this, the mother called her husband - who was a police officer - and asked him to bring their son to the exam. He did, and since the son did not need the money any more, he gave it back to his father, who returned it to the mother. At the end of the day, the whole family reported the car theft.

items.title: Another two bite the dust
items.surface: Two men are beating each other up and both of them suddenly fall to the floor.
items.truth: The daughter of one of the boxers had been kidnapped and she would be killed if her father won the fight. At the end of the fight, the boxer's opponent fainted and the other boxer - in order not to win the match - threw himself to the floor.

items.title: Death under an umbrella
items.surface: A couple find a man's corpse on the beach. The corpse is under an umbrella and has a knife on his back. There are no signs of violence and no traces of blood. The autopsy reveals that the man died of natural causes.
items.truth: The man, who had a tattoo of a knife on his back, died of a heart attack.

items.title: Time to sleep
items.surface: A woman is watching a movie. Suddenly she hears a lot of explosions and people screaming outside. Then there is silence. The woman turns off the TV and goes to sleep.
items.truth: It was New Year's Eve. The woman waited until everyone had finished celebrating and then went to bed.

items.title: Prison break
items.surface: Michael is in prison. One day, he has luch, goes to prison courtyard for a while and finally visits the library. At dusk, out of the reach of the security cameras, he changes his clothes. He then goes through the door to leave the prison, without being caught.
items.truth: Michael worked as a guard in the prison.

items.title: Restless sleep
items.surface: Paul comes home tired. He goes to his room and turns off the light to sleep. After a while, feeling uneasy, he turns on the light and looks around. He turns the light back off and tries to sleep again. After repeating this several times, he takes a look under his bed and finds a dead body.
items.truth: A thief was stealing from Paul's home. When Paul arrived home, the thief hid under the bed. The tension became too much and the thief suffered a sudden heart attack Paul was unable to sleep due to the ticking of the thief's wristwatch.

items.title: Doctor, doctor
items.surface: A man goes to the doctor to get the results of some previous tests. The results do not show up any health issues. However, he commits suicide shortly after the visit.
items.truth: The patient knew that his wife was cheating on him, but he only knew the lover's name. His wife swore to him that this lover did not exist. However when the man left the doctor's, he saw the lover's name on the report. He realized his wife was cheating on him with the doctor and could not cope with it.

items.title: Splish, splash!
items.surface: Tim is sailing his boat when his watch falls overboard. He is a great diver. However, he does not manage to retrieve the watch.
items.truth: Tim was sailing on the Dead Sea. Due to the high salt concentration, he couldn't dive deep enough to get his watch back.

items.title: The albatross
items.surface: A man goes into a restaurant, orders albatross, eats one bite, and kills himself. Why?
items.truth:
The man was in a ship that was wrecked on a desert island. When there was no food left, another passenger brought what he said was albatross but was really part of the man's wife (who had died in the wreck). The man suspects something fishy, so when they finally return to civilization, he orders albatross , realizes that what he ate before was his wife, and kills himself. 

 (there is also a version of the riddle with an abalone instead of an albatross)

items.title: The smile
items.surface:
Eugene was watching his relatives and friends being killed, but he couldn’t wipe the smile

off his face.
items.truth:
Eugene worked as a clown in a circus. Once, animals escaped from

their enclosures during a performance, and everyone broke into a run. People

and members of his family were dying in the stampede. But he couldn’t wipe the

smile off his face because of the clown makeup.

items.title: Caught up
items.surface: Tony ran out of the building, carrying two bags. Another man ran after him, shouting and waving knives.
items.truth: Tony was shopping in the store, he spent a lot of money, so the shop workers decided to give him a gift: a set of kitchen knives. Tony was in a hurry so he ran to his car, forgetting about it. The worker noticed this and ran after Tony to give him the gift.

items.title: Sacred death
items.surface: When the priest stopped talking, Bobby died.
items.truth: Bobby was a little hamster who had come to the church along with Tom, his 9-year-old owner. When the priest was speaking in front of the believers, the little hamster escaped from the child's lap and went to the altar. When the priest finished speaking and headed towards his chair, he did not see Bobby and crushed him with his foot.

items.title: That trip
items.surface: A man comes breathless out of a house, closes the door and goes quickly down stairs. Then he walks two blocks to get to another house, enters and breathes relieved.
items.truth: The man had just moved. He arrived to his new home with the last boxes and he breathed a sigh of relief because he had finished.

items.title: The Flat Tire
items.surface: The man was going to go to work by car, but found that one of the tires was flat. Without doing anything, he got into the car and drove 20 kilometers to work and then back home, without the slightest embarrassment. How could he manage it?
items.truth: The tire was flat on the spare wheel, which was in the trunk.

items.title: More cats
items.surface: A woman went on vacation and asked a friend to look after her cat. A week later, 8 cats were running around the apartment!
items.truth: The next day this cat ran away, and the friend had to start looking for it. Since he did not know the cat very well, he had to keep all the similar cats that he had seen and wait for the friend who was supposed to identify the right pet.

items.title: Rich couple
items.surface: A man and a woman got married. After the wedding they abandoned all their activities, that were bringing them money, and only had fun. As a result, in three years they became millionaires.
items.truth: Before the wedding, they were billionaires. Therefore during these three years they spent a lot of money and as a result became millionaires.

items.title: The Hanged Man
items.surface: John was walking along the snow-covered field. When he came to a lonely tree, he saw the corpse of a man hanging on the tree. He died the last night from strangulation, but there were no traces around him, except John's ones.
items.truth: The hanged man was a skydiver. His parachute was entangled and caught on branches of the tree.

items.title: The Train
items.surface: The man was walking along the rails and suddenly he saw a train coming towards him. Then he ran like hell to meet the approaching train.
items.truth: The man was in a tunnel and, in order to save his own life, he had to run along the rails to meet the train. When the tunnel was over, he was able to jump off the rails. And thanks to that, he remained alive.

items.title: The Chase
items.surface: A man is running, a crowd is running after him. The man is screaming to the crowd:"You will never see the gold!" and he starts shooting. People who observe all that are exulting.
items.truth: It was the biathlon.

items.title: Betrayal
items.surface: A man returns from a business trip, he rings a door, his wife opens it. He immediately accused her of betrayal.
items.truth: On the way back home, this man decided to visit his friend. And the door was opened by his own half-dressed wife.

items.title: Fatal shot
items.surface: A hunter aimed his gun carefully and fired. Seconds later, he realized his mistake. Minutes later, he was dead.
items.truth: He hunted in snow-capped mountains. The shot provoked an avalanche, which covered the man. He died of strangulation.

items.title: High price
items.surface: Andrew decided to spend the evening with his family. He bought tickets for the whole family, but his ticket cost him his life.
items.truth: Andrew took his family to the zoo. He found the tickets too expensive. So, he decided not to buy a ticket for himself. He climbed over the wall but got into a cage with a lion. When he realized what happened, it was too late.

items.title: Bait
items.surface: In the middle of the ocean is a yacht. Several corpses are floating in the water nearby.
items.truth:
A group of people were on an ocean voyage in a yacht. One day, they decided to go swimming — they put on their swimsuits and dove off the side. They discovered belatedly that they have forgotten to put a ladder down the side of the yacht and were unable to climb back in, so they drowned. 

 Alternate Solution (choose one): 

 The same situation, but they set out a ladder that was just barely long enough. When they dove into the water, the boat, without their weight, rose slightly in the water, putting the ladder just out of reach.

items.title: Dry
items.surface: A man dies of thirst at home. How could it happen?
items.truth: The man’s home was a yacht, in which he was travelling around the world. While sailing in the ocean, he ran out of fresh water much faster than he expected.

items.title: The Flayer
items.surface: The man received the parcel in which he found a dead mouse. He reported this to the police, and the sender of this parcel was found guilty of fraud.
items.truth: The sender was supposed to send the jewels to this man. He hoped that the mouse would gnaw a hole in the box and run away, and nobody could blame on him for the loss.
